**Job title** : *R70001043*

* **Location** : Hyderabad

Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** .


Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by **making self\-care as simple as it should be** . For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.


At the core of this mission is our **100 loved brands** , our **11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites** and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.


**As a globally certified B Corp company,** we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com .


***About the job:***

Our team is engaged in designing and delivering Digital Tech Services worldwide. We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting highly regulated environments (GxP, SoX, and other regional and local regulations). Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world. To reach our goals we have organized our model around 7 main pillars:


· Enterprise architecture


· Cloud Infrastructure \& Engineering Platforms


· Digital Workplace


· Integration Platform


· ERP


· Service Now Platform


· Salesforce Platform


***Main Responsibilities:***

This position is a senior role responsible for coordinating and ensuring the successful execution of all release management activities related to Integration changes (interfaces) across Opella’s global ecosystem. This includes:


· Coordinate end\-to\-end release activities for all integration\-related deployments, ensuring execution quality, schedule adherence, and risk mitigation according to the integration governance process.


· Prepare, maintain, and communicate the integrated release calendar for all interface deployments across the Integration Platforms.


· Perform detailed readiness checks, ensuring all prerequisite activities, build, testing, documentation and approvals are fully completed prior to release execution.


· Oversee the creation, validation, and execution of release plans, including rollback strategies, dependency management, and release sequencing.


· Act as the primary point of contact during release windows, coordinating cross\-functional teams (Integration, Infra, SAP, project teams, vendors) to ensure smooth deployment.


· Ensure adherence to governance, compliance, and quality requirements related to Integration deployment activities (GxP, SoX, InfoSec, data privacy).


· Coordinate post release validation and ensure defects/issues are properly tracked, assessed, and resolved.


· Contribute to continuous improvements in release processes, including automation, documentation, monitoring, and communication practices.


· Maintain dashboards, KPIs, and reporting to provide visibility into release performance, trends, and future capacity needs.


· Foster strong collaboration with project managers, product owners, developers, testers, and operational support teams.


· Promote and advocate best practices in Integration release management, ensuring consistent execution across all markets and platforms.


· Own and evolve the integration catalog as the main artifact repository for Interfaces.


***About You:***

**Technical Background Required**

· 10\+ years of experience in Release Management, Integration technologies, or similar roles supporting complex enterprise landscapes.


· Good understanding of Integration technologies, API lifecycle, messaging patterns, middleware concepts, and interface operations.


· Proven experience planning and coordinating releases within enterprise environments, ideally including cloud and hybrid architectures.


· Knowledge of SDLC, CI/CD principles, DevOps practices, and deployment automation.


· Experience working with highly regulated sectors or compliance\-driven environments is a strong plus (GxP, SoX, InfoSec).


· Good understanding of infrastructure, networking, and application dependencies relevant to interface deployments.


· Familiarity with modern digital technologies: Cloud platforms (Azure), API gateways, iPaaS, DevSecOps, Infra\-as\-Code, observability tools, etc.


· Excellent communication abilities to articulate release plans, risks, and impacts to technical and business stakeholders.


· Experience with ERP systems, particularly SAP integration processes, is a plus.


**Soft Skills Required**

· Excellent coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple releases and priorities simultaneously.


· Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to remain calm and effective in high\-pressure release windows.


· Ability to work cross\-functionally in a global matrix environment, fostering collaboration and alignment.


· Strong communication skills: clear, concise, and able to translate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.


· Proactive mindset with a continuous improvement orientation.


· Demonstrated accountability, ownership, and attention to detail.


· Ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and drive disciplined execution.


***Why us?***

At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - CRM Innovation & Experimentation
jobs.description:
### **Summary**

Novartis is on a mission to transform medicine and improve lives worldwide. As a global leader in healthcare, we leverage advanced technology, data, and digital capabilities to deliver patient\-centric solutions, enhance customer engagement, and drive innovation. Within this context, the US CRM organization plays a critical role in shaping the transformation to next\-generation CRM Innovation Labs that identifies and tests opportunities that can improve customer engagement, user experience, productivity, and CRM capabilities. Its work combines structured discovery, rapid experimentation, and evidence\-based recommendations.  

  

The Senior Manager, CRM Innovation \& Experimentation leads defined innovation opportunities and experiments within the Hyderabad Labs extension. Reporting to the Director, CRM Enablement, Hyderabad, the role partners with the Associate Director, CRM Innovation Labs, US Labs leadership, Product Owners, business teams, technology partners, and control functions to scout emerging possibilities, run prototypes and proofs of concept, coordinate internal and external contributors, and convert learning into decision\-ready recommendations.
### **About the Role**

**Senior Manager \- CRM Innovation \& Experimentation**

**Location – Hyderabad \#LI Hybrid**

**Major Accountabilities:**

* Explore business challenges, user needs, product gaps, market trends, and emerging technologies to identify relevant CRM opportunities.
* Scout and assess startups, technology providers, specialist partners, and external capabilities against defined business needs and experiment objectives.
* Triage opportunities to determine whether they require experimentation, can reuse existing CRM capabilities, or should be redirected to another accountable team.
* Shape selected opportunities into clear problem statements, hypotheses, expected benefits, success measures, assumptions, risks, and decision criteria.
* Lead timeboxed discovery, prototyping, proof\-of\-concept, user validation, and technical feasibility activities, ensuring required data, environments, integrations, access, and specialist support are in place.
* Coordinate cross\-functional contributors, including Product Owners, business SMEs, UX, architecture, engineering, data, analytics, privacy, security, legal, compliance, procurement, delivery teams, contractors, and external partners.
* Synthesize user, business, technical, operational, and market evidence into recommendations to advance, pivot, pause, stop, or transition opportunities, including reuse, configuration, process change, or existing\-product enhancement options.
* Maintain strong execution discipline and governance through experiment plans, backlogs, decision records, risks, dependencies, stakeholder updates, transition\-ready documentation, reusable insights, and compliance with responsible\-use, data, privacy, security, legal, procurement, and documentation requirements.

**Essential Requirements:**

* Quality and timeliness of opportunity briefs, experiment plans, prototypes, evidence packs, and recommendations.
* Clarity of hypotheses, benefit measures, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and decision records.
* Speed of learning and reduction of business, user, technical, operational, or compliance uncertainty.
* Relevance and quality of external capabilities assessed or translated into experiments.
* Effectiveness of stakeholder and contractor coordination, deliverables, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
* Quality and readiness of handovers into product roadmaps, operational capabilities, or other agreed adoption pathways.

**Educational Requirement:**


Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, life sciences, engineering, or a related field is required; MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred

**Minimum Experience:**

* 9\+ years of experience in digital innovation, product management, consulting, technology scouting, prototyping, CRM, or related disciplines.
* Hands\-on experience shaping ambiguous opportunities and leading experiments from hypothesis through evidence\-based recommendation.
* Experience evaluating startups, technology providers, vendors, or external capabilities.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional workstreams, contractors, or specialist partners.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder\-management, and execution capabilities.
* Experience working in agile, product\-oriented, global, or distributed environments.
* Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or another regulated industry is desirable.

**Desirable Requirement :**

**Navigate Complexity** \- Convert ambiguous opportunities into focused experiments and clear decisions.

**Deliver Collective Impact** \- Coordinate internal teams, contractors, external partners, and control functions toward shared outcomes.

**Influence Without Authority** \- Build credibility through evidence, demonstrations, user input, and clear recommendations.

**Drive Ownership \& Execution** \- Manage scope, milestones, dependencies, quality, documentation, and escalation.

**Continuous Learning** \- Translate emerging trends and experiment lessons into relevant CRM opportunities and reusable practices.


**Why Novartis:** Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people\-and\-culture

**Benefits and Rewards:** Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.

jobs.description:
Takes a fully independent lead in several areas of product development by following the principles of Agile to manage the team backlog, anticipate and prioritize needs, oversee development stages, act as a primary liaison and evaluate product progress. Serves as the customer proxy; works collaboratively with business owners and other stakeholders to accomplish these tasks with little to no support with a high volume of work and increased complexity. Utilizes strong understanding of the business vision to to regularly contribute and manage execution. Heavily influences the business owner's requirements, the Product Manager's program vision and roadmap while introducing new and useful tools and practices to drive continuous improvement. Provides overall leadership to Product Owner team through mentorship and guidance and provides back up to Product Manager, as needed.


Essential Job Functions
Applies basic scientific practice within iterations in order to routinely plan, do, check and adjust. Manages team backlog items and prioritizes based on business value. Outlines dependencies and informs stakeholders the necessary sequence of development to ensure optimized performance and outcomes. Holds a significant role in quality control and is the primary team member empowered to accept stories as done. Utilizes advanced business knowledge, based on prior experience within business function, and communication skills to anticipate problems and address them accordingly. Works cross functionally in a self\-organizing manner to accomplish tasks and effectively manage the backlog. Leads processes and procedure changes identified by teams by working with external business partners. Effectively applies critical thinking to identify flexibility in determining how and when each iteration and product element will be developed. Acts as primary communicator and connection between stakeholders, end users and teams determining if each story meets their shared e xpectations. Ensures collaboration from all stakeholders on decisions and strategy providing clear instructions and deliverables for developers. Takes ownership for each stage of the process and final product to ensure the goal and vision are correctly aligned with the work items on the backlog. Contributes strategic input into the prioritization of the program backlog, coordinates dependencies and manages the inspection and evaluation of product progress through each iteration. Drives the mitigation of program risks. Leads PO and/or ART sync meetings in addition to the system demo to show critical aspects of the solution. Leads in Inspect \& Adapt (I\&A) workshop to work across teams to define and implement improvement stories to increase program quality. A key member of the Agile team who utilizes perspective to define iteration goals and drives execution and delivery. Partners with the business owner to understand needs, manage scope and add/eliminate user stories while contributing heavy influence to build an effective strategy. Communicates requirements to Agile Team in a clear and collaborative manner to determine new requirements, negotiate teams and dependencies. Regularly interacts closely with the Product Manager in order to discuss goals and vision of the business/value stream, sharing extensive knowledge in order to make sound decisions. Heavily involved in the Program Increment (PI) planning, story definition and assists team with story estimates and sequencing. Oversees the development of the product to include planning, refinement, review, and execution. Partners with stakeholders to identify and organize steps required for next iteration. Works to gain clarity on queries and participate in the demo of committed items. Participates in ceremonies within the team to coordinate efforts with team to refine the process, identify areas for improvement and support the execution of tasks. Continuously keeps the end\-user needs in mind based on higher level of business acumen to ensure the solution meets expectations and the development delivers expected outcomes from the accepted stories. Independently represents business owners' interest and prioritize user stories based on business value while maximizing agile team's capacity. Provides mentorship and guidance to PO I and II. jobs.description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.



We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.


**Role description:**



Are you an experienced Senior Product Designer who thrives on solving complex problems and creating intuitive digital experiences?



At Arcadis, we design and build digital products that help our consultants, clients, and project teams work smarter, make better decisions, and deliver greater impact. Our applications support complex business processes, data\-driven decision making, operational workflows, and the management of natural and built assets across a wide range of industries and markets.



As a Senior Product Designer, you will play a key role in shaping enterprise\-scale products that simplify complexity and enable users to work more efficiently and effectively. You will collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, domain experts, and stakeholders across the business to transform complex requirements, data, and workflows into seamless user experiences.



You will also help strengthen our design culture by championing user\-centred design practices, contributing to our design system, and mentoring other designers.



**Role accountabilities:**



* Lead the design of complex enterprise applications from discovery through delivery.
* Transform complex workflows, business processes, and data into intuitive user experiences.
* Partner with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to define problems, shape solutions, and drive outcomes.
* Conduct user research, validate concepts, and use insights to inform design decisions.
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs that balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
* Contribute to and evolve the Arcadis Design System, championing accessibility, consistency, and quality.
* Leverage AI to enhance the design process and help shape AI\-enabled product experiences that improve productivity and decision\-making.
* Mentor designers and help foster a collaborative, user\-centred design culture.
**Qualifications \& Experience:**



* 5\+ years of experience in Product Design, UX Design, or a related discipline.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating end\-to\-end design of complex web\-based products or enterprise applications.
* Experience simplifying complex workflows, operational processes, or data\-rich experiences into intuitive solutions.
* Proficiency in user research, interaction design, information architecture, and prototyping.
* Experience working with and contributing to design systems.
* Understanding of AI\-assisted design practices and emerging AI interaction patterns.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional and globally distributed teams.

***Portfolio requirement***


A portfolio review presentation is required as part of the interview process. Your presentation should showcase your design work, demonstrate your problem\-solving approach, and illustrate how you translate complex business or user challenges into effective product solutions.


Your resume must include a link to your design portfolio.


Why Arcadis?



We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.



You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.



Together, we can create a lasting legacy.



Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.



Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging



We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day, which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people.

 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions.  Zato is building the next generation of AI\-powered accounting and financial\-close software. We combine intelligent automation, agentic AI, and enterprise\-grade compliance to help accounting and finance teams close faster, work smarter, and stay audit\-ready without the manual grind. We're growing fast, and product is at the centre of that growth.
 




  





**Why Zato Labs** 





 Zato Labs is where research and innovation come first. It's the space where we prototype bold ideas, stress\-test agentic AI concepts, and turn ambiguous, forward\-looking problems into real, validated product bets before they ever become someone else's roadmap deadline. Labs work moves fast, tolerates dead ends, and rewards people who'd rather define a category than maintain one. If that's the kind of ambiguity you thrive in, we'd love to talk.
 




  





**About the Role** 





 As a Product Manager at Zato Labs, you'll own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of a research\-driven product initiative from a rough hypothesis to a validated, production\-ready capability. You'll work across the full breadth of Zato's platform, drawing on whichever domains a given bet calls for:

 Integrations — connecting Zato to the broader financial and business ecosystem

 Coordinate with QA on testing and quality bar, and with the PMO on release sequencing

 6–8 years of Product Management experience

 Domain depth in one or more of: accounting/compliance, workflow systems, intelligent classification, agentic AI, or integrations

 Ability to translate ambiguous, technical, or domain\-heavy requirements into clear, buildable product requirements

 Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills

 Prior experience in 0\-to\-1 or innovation\-lab environments

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role summary:**
 This is an inbound technical product manager role. You'll own the design and delivery of ServiceNow's ITSM and ITOM products — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB — in a live production environment, measure how they actually perform, and use that evidence to influence what the products should become.
   

  

 Three things make this role distinct from a standard implementation specialist:
   

  

* You own the outcome, not the deployment. Go\-live is the midpoint. You instrument the solution, track adoption and performance in production, and iterate when the data says the design didn't land.
* You're the voice of the customer, from inside. You'll partner directly with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — evaluating new and pre\-GA capability under real operational load, documenting gaps with evidence, and tracking them to closure.
* You can carry the story upward. You'll represent this work in executive forums, translating implementation detail into the impact language leadership needs to make decisions.


 You'll spend part of your week across the table from business stakeholders shaping requirements, part with engineering getting it built, and part with Product shaping the roadmap. If you only want one of those three, this isn't the role.
   

  

**What You Get To Do**
**Shape the solution**
* Run discovery sessions with business stakeholders and process owners to understand current\-state pain, process gaps, and desired outcomes
* Translate business requirements into a recommended ServiceNow solution design, and pitch it credibly — including where out\-of\-box beats customization and where scope should be cut
* Drive alignment across competing stakeholders, secure sign\-off on scope and design decisions, and document the agreed solution


**Deliver it with engineering**
* Translate approved designs into deployable epics and stories with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies, and definition of done — well\-formed enough that engineering can build without guessing
* Walk engineering through design intent, defend the "why" behind decisions, and work through technical trade\-offs and constraints collaboratively as build progresses
* Act as the single point of translation between engineering and the business. When engineering needs clarification, you go get it — you own the round trip back to the business stakeholder rather than pulling engineers into stakeholder meetings to ask directly
* Manage scope, sequencing, and backlog priority with engineering through the build, and unblock decisions rather than escalating them
* Own UAT coordination, go\-live readiness, and hypercare
* Advise on platform best practices, upgrade\-safe design, and technical debt avoidance


**Measure it**
* Instrument every implementation for measurability from day one — define success metrics and baselines before build starts, not after go\-live
* Personally build and maintain the reports and dashboards that show whether the solution is actually delivering: adoption, deflection, cycle time, process compliance, data quality, and where the process is leaking
* Use the data to drive iteration — surface underperformance to stakeholders proactively, recommend fixes, and close the loop rather than declaring victory at deployment


**Accelerate it**
* Use AI tooling to compress delivery cycles — apply general\-purpose AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate requirements synthesis, data analysis, rapid prototyping of solution concepts for stakeholder validation, test case generation, and documentation — and bring a point of view on where AI genuinely speeds delivery versus where it adds noise


**Influence the product**
* Represent your work in executive forums like monthly product reviews: what you delivered, why that approach, and what measurable impact it created. Distill technical detail into outcome language a VP can act on
* Partner with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — build durable working relationships with the teams building these products, evaluate new and pre\-GA capabilities in a real production environment, and provide grounded, constructive feedback based on actual adoption experience
* Own the product gap loop — document capability gaps that block or slow adoption, translate them into clear, evidence\-backed asks with business impact attached, and track them through to closure with Product and Engineering rather than logging them and moving on


**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8\+ years delivering ServiceNow solutions, with at least 3 full lifecycle ITSM and ITOM deployments owned end to end
* Prior product management experience, formal or informal
* Experience operating in an internal IT / Customer Zero model, deploying capability before general availability
* Exposure to enterprise CMDB remediation at scale
* Experience with AI\-driv…

jobs.title: Security Analyst, Attack Surface Management
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Security Analyst, Attack Surface Management


**Summary**



The Attack Surface Management team owns what happens after a vulnerability is found. Findings arrive from red team pentests, adversary simulations, external bug bounty submissions, and scanning coverage. This role validates them, determines real impact, and drives them to closure with the engineering teams that own the affected assets. Critical findings route to Incident Response. Everything rated High and Medium is this team's responsibility until it is patched or a compensating control is in place and documented.



This is not a patch operations role. Separate teams apply fixes. This role decides what matters, why it matters, and holds the line until it is resolved.


**Responsibilities**


* Triage and validate inbound Bugcrowd submissions: reproduce the reported issue, confirm or reject it, deduplicate against known findings, and determine payout\-relevant severity.
* Independently assess impact rather than accepting a submitter's or a scanner's rating. Factor in exploitability, asset exposure, data sensitivity, authentication requirements, and existing controls.
* Track High and Medium findings from red team engagements and adversary simulations through remediation, including retest and closure verification.
* Evaluate and document compensating controls where a fix is not immediately viable, and set expiry conditions rather than leaving exceptions open indefinitely.
* Write remediation guidance that an application or platform engineer can act on without further translation.
* Escalate Critical findings to Incident Response with the reproduction detail and blast radius assessment they need to act.
* Partner with application owners and product teams on remediation timelines, and raise risk acceptance decisions to leadership when timelines slip.
* Maintain visibility into externally exposed assets and flag newly surfaced attack surface for assessment.


**Required Qualifications**


* Two or more years in application security, vulnerability management, penetration testing, or bug bounty work.
* Working proficiency in web application and API penetration testing. You should be able to independently reproduce a submitted finding, escalate it if the submitter undersold it, and prove it is a false positive if it is one.
* Practical knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10, including what remediation actually looks like for each class of issue.
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT\&CK techniques and the ability to connect a finding to how an attacker would chain it.
* Severity determination beyond a CVSS calculator. You can explain why a High\-scoring finding on an isolated internal asset may matter less than a Medium on an internet\-facing authentication flow.
* Hands\-on experience with Burp Suite and standard web and API testing tooling.
* Clear written communication. Much of this role is convincing an engineering team that a finding is real and worth their sprint capacity.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Demonstrated bug bounty track record on Bugcrowd, HackerOne, or Intigriti.
* Experience triaging submissions from the program side.
* Cloud security exposure across AWS or Azure, particularly identity and storage misconfigurations.
* Certifications such as BSCP, OSWA, OSCP, CPTS, or PNPT. A public bug bounty profile carries equal weight.

jobs.title: Senior QA
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Senior QA to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in both manual and automation testing, with strong exposure to web, API, and mobile application testing. This role requires someone who can independently drive testing activities, build and maintain automation frameworks, identify quality risks, and work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software.

  

The candidate should demonstrate strong ownership, sound technical judgment, and problem\-solving skills. We are also looking for someone who is interested in continuously exploring modern QA technologies and practices, including AI\-assisted testing, to improve test coverage, efficiency, and overall product quality.

 **Key Responsibilities**


* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into comprehensive test strategies, test scenarios, and test cases.
* Independently plan and execute functional, regression, integration, system, end\-to\-end, exploratory, and release testing.
* Design, develop, maintain, and improve automated test frameworks using Playwright and/or Selenium.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts using C\#, and Python.
* Perform comprehensive API testing using Postman, Fiddler, Swagger, or similar tools.
* Perform web and mobile application testing across Android and iOS platforms.
* Perform database validation using SQL queries and verify data integrity across different application layers.
* Analyze test failures, investigate issues, identify root causes, and work closely with developers to resolve defects.
* Manage the complete defect lifecycle using Jira, MTM, Bugzilla, Visual Studio, or similar test and defect management tools.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and contribute to continuous testing practices.
* Work with cloud environments such as Azure and/or AWS.
* Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of automation frameworks, testing processes, and QA standards.
* Explore and apply AI tools and AI\-assisted testing techniques to improve test coverage, productivity, test maintenance, defect analysis, and automation.
* Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other stakeholders.
* Support release validation and provide clear updates on test status, quality risks, defects, and overall test progress.
* Mentor and support junior QA engineers when required.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, automation coverage, and overall testing practices.

  


**Required Skills and Experience**


* 3–5 years of professional experience in Software Testing or Quality Assurance.
* Strong hands\-on experience in both Manual and Automation Testing.
* Strong experience working with Playwright and/or Selenium.
* Hands\-on programming experience in C\#, Python for test automation.
* Strong experience in API testing using Postman, Fiddler, Swagger, or similar tools.
* Experience testing web and mobile applications.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and database testing.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience working with test and defect management tools such as Jira, MTM, Bugzilla, QTP, Visual Studio, or similar tools.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing practices.
* Experience working with Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Practical understanding or experience using AI tools and AI\-assisted software testing.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently plan, manage, and drive testing activities.

  


**Nice to Have**


* Experience designing or improving automation frameworks.
* Experience working with multi\-platform applications across web, API, and mobile.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Exposure to performance, security, or other non\-functional testing.
* Experience mentoring or supporting junior QA engineers.
* Experience using AI\-powered tools to improve test automation, test design, defect analysis, or QA productivity.

  


**What We Offer**


* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, certification, and career advancement.
* Exposure to modern cloud\-native technologies and enterprise\-scale projects.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and innovation\-driven work environment.
* Flexible work arrangements and opportunities to work with global teams.

 **Product Manager**

================

* Hyderabad, India

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

  

**About the Role:**
===================


**Grade Level (for internal use):**


07
**Role**
The **Data Analyst**is an individual contributor role that develops foundational proficiency in one or more workflows or
  

datasets. The role supports end\-to\-end data lifecycle activities including sourcing, basic validation, enrichment, and delivery under
  

guidance, adhering strictly to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and set guidelines, and escalating deviations for a defined
  

dataset or workflow.
  

The role emphasizes building strong data literacy and operational discipline, learning industry concepts, and collaborating with other
  

data research teams. Associates contribute to UAT and day\-to\-day solutioning, follow established standards, and participate in
  

continuous process improvement and the adoption of technology and AI\-enabled workflows.
  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Process and analyze financial documents received from **General****/Limited****Partners**, including capital calls, distributions, financial statements, and schedules of investments.
* Access GP portals and repositories to **download, categorize, and tag** fund\-related documents with accurate metadata.
* Extract, standardize, and validate data from Private Equity documents such as **Partners’ Capital Account statements, cash flow statements, and investment schedules**.
* Identify appropriate accounting breakouts and classify data items related to **fund\-level investments and portfolio companies**.
* Perform data quality checks, resolve exceptions raised through **manual QC reviews and automated validation logs**, and ensure adherence to defined data standards.
* Conduct routine reporting and **basic trend analysis** to support internal analytics and operational insights.
* Support **data cleansing initiatives** to improve accuracy and consistency across datasets.
* Assist with **process improvement, Lean initiatives, and automation efforts**, including basic SQL\-driven data tasks.
* Maintain clear documentation of data collection and validation processes for auditability and future reference.
* Collaborate with team members to deliver **individual and team targets** with a strong focus on quality, accuracy, and timeliness.
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects aligned to business expansion, data enhancement, or automation initiatives.
  

**Basic Qualification**
* **Fresher (2025/2026 passouts) \-**Bachelor's/Masters degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce.
* Excellent in written \& verbal communication
* Willing to work in rotational shift (including night shift) basis the business requirement
* Basic understanding of financial/market or domain data concepts relevant to the assigned dataset.

  

**Technical Skills**
* Familiarity with structured/unstructured data formats (Excel, PDFs, filings, news, vendor feeds, etc).
* Beginner knowledge of SQL/Excel for querying, filtering, and reconciling data.
* Awareness of automation and GenAI tools; ability to follow prescribed usage patterns.
* Exposure to data lifecycle concepts (source ingest validate publish).

  

**Functional Skills**
* Ability to perform data entry, tagging, and basic enrichment accurately.
* Capability to read and interpret simple source materials (e.g., filings, vendor feeds, news).
* Structured escalation of exceptions with appropriate evidence and context.
* Ability to quickly learn and work with enterprise data capture tools, workflow systems, and ticketing platforms.
**What’s In It For** **You?**


**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.


**Our People:**


We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.


**Our Values:**
  

**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

  

  

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  

  

**Benefits:**

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S\&P Global.
  

  

Our benefits include:


* Health \& Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
* Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
* Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
* Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company\-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
* Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S\&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best\-in class benefits for families.
* Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/be…

**Business Performance \& Analytics Analyst (GCF 04A)**

**Function: Global Supply Chain**

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Reports To: Business Performance \& Analytics Analyst Manager, Amgen India**

**Role Summary**


The Business Performance \& Analytics Analyst supports the Global Planning Network and site Supply Chain organizations by delivering business intelligence, analytics, reporting, visualization, financial insights, and digital solutions that enable data\-driven decision making across the end\-to\-end supply chain.


The role partners with Global Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Digital Technology, and Site Supply Chain Operations to transform operational, planning, and financial data into actionable business insights. This position is responsible for developing enterprise reporting, performance dashboards, planning analytics, KPI scorecards, and automation solutions that improve forecast accuracy, inventory optimization, manufacturing performance, service levels, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.


The analyst also supports continuous improvement initiatives through process standardization, automation, AI\-enabled analytics, and self\-service reporting capabilities while ensuring data integrity, governance, and compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Business Performance \& Analytics**

* Develop and maintain enterprise dashboards, KPI scorecards, and performance reporting that support the Global Planning Network and Site Supply Chain organisations.
* Analyse operational, planning, manufacturing, inventory, procurement, logistics and financial data to identify trends, risks, opportunities and performance improvement initiatives.
* Deliver recurring and ad hoc analytics to support Integrated Business Planning (IBP), S\&OP, operational reviews, governance forums and executive decision\-making.
* Translate complex data into actionable business insights and recommendations for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Develop executive\-level visualisations that improve business visibility and support strategic planning.

**2\. Planning Network Analytics**


Provide analytics and reporting support across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Inventory Planning and Integrated Business Planning processes.


Monitor, analyse and report planning performance metrics including:

**Supply Planning**

* Supply / Production Plan Adherence
* Capacity Utilisation and Constraints
* Network Inventory Performance
* Inventory Health and Abnormal Scrap

**Raw Materials Planning**

* Material Availability
* Supplier Performance
* Purchase Order Adherence
* Inventory Health, Ageing, Excess and Obsolete Materials
* Raw Material Supply Risk Indicators


Partner with planning teams to identify opportunities to improve forecast accuracy, inventory optimisation, service levels and supply reliability.

**3\. Site Supply Chain Analytics**


Provide analytics and reporting that support manufacturing execution, inventory management, warehousing, operational planning, inspection readiness and continuous improvement initiatives.


Key responsibilities include:

* Monitor and report inventory levels across all stages of manufacturing and supply.
* Analyse warehouse utilisation, inventory health and abnormal scrap performance.
* Support operational reviews through the delivery of timely analytics, business insights and performance reporting.
* Manage and maintain key site supply chain reports, dashboards and visualisation tools.
* Generate data extracts and analytics supporting operational reviews, regulatory inspections, business continuity activities and site performance management.

**4\. Supply Chain Systems \& Digital Solutions**


Provide functional support and continuous improvement for supply chain systems, data, reporting platforms and system integrations.


Key responsibilities include:

* Support SAP Supply Chain processes including Warehouse Management (WM), Production Planning (PP), Order\-to\-Cash (OTC), Master Data and Quality Management.
* Provide functional support for SAP GUI transactions, SAP Fiori applications and connected platforms including MES, Maximo and Ariba.
* Troubleshoot user issues, reporting discrepancies, system errors and interface\-related challenges.
* Support user access management, testing activities, documentation, training and user adoption initiatives.
* Partner with Digital Technology, SAP functional and technical teams to implement enhancements, resolve issues and improve system performance.
* Design, develop and maintain reporting and visualisation solutions using Tableau, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud or similar platforms.
* Develop self\-service reporting capabilities and automate recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and business visibility.

**5\. Financial Analytics, Continuous Improvement \& Automation**


Support supply chain financial performance while driving process optimisation, automation and data\-driven decision making.


Key responsibilities include:

* Support budgeting, forecasting, accrual management, invoice reconciliation, cost centre management, logistics charges and budget performance tracking.
* Analyse and reconcile operational and financial data to identify cost drivers, forecast spend and assess budget adherence.
* Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to understand financial impacts associated with inventory, manufacturing, logistics and scrap performance.

* Improve data quality, governance and reporting consis…

jobs.description:
**Join Us as a Customer Delivery Analyst!**
Are you ready to make a significant impact in an innovative environment? At ORBCOMM, we're looking for a Customer Delivery Analyst who can transform complex operational data into meaningful insights that improve performance, decision\-making, and customer experience.  

If you thrive at the intersection of data, technology, and operations and enjoy turning business questions into actionable solutions, we'd love to hear from you. **Why You'll Love Working Here**
As a member of the Customer Delivery team, you'll support key functions across Customer Experience, Technical Operations, Order Management, Planning, Strategic Sourcing, and more. You'll help design and implement KPIs, automate reporting, and integrate operational data into ORBCOMM's organizational Data Lake.  

Your work will help turn business data into action, improve visibility across Customer Delivery, and shape processes that support scalable growth.  

This role is based out of our Hyderabad, India hub and operates within ORBCOMM's hybrid work environment. **What You'll Do****Data Analytics \& Reporting*** Utilize enterprise data sources, including ERP, CRM, PLM, and operational systems, to create dashboards and visualizations for leadership and operational teams.
* Develop, monitor, and refine KPIs supporting Customer Delivery performance, forecast accuracy, and operational execution.
* Build and automate reporting solutions using Excel, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SQL, and other analytics tools.
* Support the integration of operational data and reporting into ORBCOMM's organizational Data Lake.

**Operational Insights \& Support*** Analyze order fulfillment, supply chain performance, and customer delivery metrics to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Investigate data anomalies, validate system data, and support root\-cause analysis.
* Translate data into actionable insights for Customer Delivery, Planning, Logistics, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Provide analytical support for operational planning and decision\-making.

**Systems \& Data Management*** Work with ERP systems such as SAP and JDE, Salesforce, and PLM platforms to extract, validate, and maintain critical datasets.
* Support the accuracy of key master data related to customers, products, and delivery commitments.
* Partner with IT, Operations, and Product teams to improve data flows, system configurations, and reporting structures.

**Process Improvement \& Collaboration*** Partner across Customer Delivery, Supply Chain, Finance, Sales, and IT to improve reporting, workflows, and operational processes.
* Support or lead initiatives focused on improving data accuracy, forecasting consistency, and delivery visibility.
* Provide business support for new tool implementations, data migrations, and reporting enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.

 **Who You Are**
You're an analytical problem solver who combines strong technical capabilities with business acumen. If you have:* 3–5 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Operations Analyst, Business Analyst, or in a related role.
* Experience working with enterprise systems including ERP platforms such as SAP or JDE, CRM platforms such as Salesforce, and PLM systems.
* Advanced Excel skills, including data modeling, transformation, and automation.
* Experience building dashboards and analytical workflows using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
* Experience developing queries, models, and measures using SQL, Power Query, and DAX.

jobs.description:
**Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning**


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value\-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision\-making through our AI\-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.


This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T\-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.

### **About the Role:**


As a Senior Manager – Product Management (Supply Chain Analytics), you will play a pivotal role in shaping the product vision and roadmap for analytics\-driven decision\-making across the supply chain. You will drive the development of advanced analytics capabilities that empower business users to optimize forecasting, inventory, procurement, and logistics performance. This is a highly cross\-functional and strategic role that sits at the intersection of product, data science, engineering, and business operations. You will be expected to work independently, influence across teams, and deliver high\-impact outcomes in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

### **What You Should Have:**

* 10\+ years of experience, with 3\+ years in product management for enterprise software, analytics platforms, or supply chain tech. Consulting experience is a plus.
* Deep understanding of supply chain planning and analytics functions – supply chain KPIs, demand/supply planning, S\&OP, procurement, logistics, inventory optimization.
* Demonstrated success in delivering supply chain assessments across Manufacturing and retail industries.

* Experienced with software implementations playing a solution architect role for supply chain analytics/planning applications and/or experience leading product build for supply chain applications.
* Familiarity with supply chain planning \& analytics tools/platforms like o9, SAP, Databricks, Tableau, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Anaplan or similar.
* Experience working with data teams with deep understanding of predictive models, scenario analysis, and optimization techniques.
* Ability to define and track supply chain KPIs for different industries including forecast accuracy, inventory turns, lead time reduction, etc.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to drive alignment across global, cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Agile product development, prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW), and iterative roadmap planning.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; confident presenting to both technical and executive stakeholders.

* Very strong analytical skills
* Educational background in Engineering, Supply Chain, Computer Science, or MBA/MS in Business/Analytics.

### **What You Will Do:**

* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for supply chain analytics solutions.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, data science, and UX to build high\-impact analytics features that solve real\-world supply chain problems.
* Engage with enterprise customers and internal users to capture needs, validate concepts, and prioritize use cases.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear, data\-driven product specifications and user stories.
* Drive delivery through sprints; ensure outcomes align with business goals and user expectations.
* Define and monitor product success using clear performance metrics and user feedback loops.
* Act as the voice of the customer and advocate for analytics as a core capability within the supply chain suite.
* Mentor and guide junior PMs, fostering a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

 **More about us…**


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3\.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest\-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI\-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision\-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real\-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.

jobs.description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Visa's Client Platforms and Enterprise Tools team owns the platforms that govern how clients and partners securely connect to Visa's APIs. As Sr. Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Visa Developer Platform's API Gateways, the encryption and key management capabilities that protect data in transit, and Visa's India data localization operations. Direct product strategy from product conception and definition through implementation. Identifies new business and market opportunities and creates appropriate business plans


All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.


Key Responsibilities

* **Own product strategy and the long\-term roadmap for the Inbound API Gateway and its associated developer portal onboarding flows**
* **Define the roadmap for authentication and encryption mechanisms supported at the gateway (mTLS, PQC, OAuth, JWT/JWK) and prioritize new auth capabilities against client and regulatory demand**
* Own security configuration capabilities such as header whitelisting, and prioritize enhancements based on emerging threat models and client requirements
* Run front\-door intake meetings and prioritize incoming feature, security, and integration requests from internal product teams and partners
* Manage the regional deployment roadmap, ensuring gateway capabilities and security configurations are rolled out consistently across regions
* Partner with security, cryptography, and platform engineering teams to validate that new authentication and encryption capabilities meet Visa's security and compliance bar
* Define and track performance key results (latency, availability, onboarding time, auth failure rates) to ensure ongoing product readiness
* Own documentation and enablement materials so internal teams and partners can self\-serve gateway onboarding and configuration
* Monitor support/incident trends related to authentication and security configuration, feeding recurring issues back into the roadmap
* Present roadmap, KPIs, and key security/compliance decisions to leadership and governance forums on a recurring cadence
* Support daily operational needs requiring data access and retrieval by India\-localized personnel, ensuring timely turnaround for internal and client requests
* Help ensure India\-localized platforms and tools run reliably as a cohesive product suite, coordinating fixes and improvements across the underlying systems


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**


Basic Qualifications:

* + 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 7 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree, or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
* + **Proven experience as a Product Manager owning API platforms, gateways, or security/authentication infrastructure**
	+ **Working knowledge of API authentication and security standards (OAuth, mTLS, JWT/JWK) and emerging areas such as post\-quantum cryptography**
	+ **Familiarity with encryption concepts (message\-level and field\-level encryption) and key management lifecycle practices**
	+ Experience running intake/prioritization processes and setting product roadmaps for multiple concurrent workstreams
	+ Experience partnering closely with security and cryptography engineering teams on regulated or compliance\-sensitive capabilities
	+ Understanding of data localization or data residency regulatory requirements is a plus
	+ Strong stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, security, and compliance partners
	+ Comfortable working with agile frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**Company Description** **Eurofins Scientific** is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.


The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.


In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.


In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Qualifications** **Principal Software Engineer**  

**Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**  

  

With 54 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies.  

  

Behind the scenes, BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next\-generation applications and Electronic Lab Notebook(ELN). These are sophisticated computer programs that will be used by our scientists, engineers, and technicians to document research, experiments, and procedures performed in our international network of laboratories.  

  

This role reports to a Engineering Manager.  

  

**Required Experience and Skills**  

  

**Experience:**

* 7 to 10 years of experience with developing end\-to\-end web applications using Microsoft stack of technologies.
* Strong working knowledge of Web application development using .NET, C\#, Asp.net, MVC, WebAPI.
* Strong Working knowledge of Angular 2 or above, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS3\.
* Good working knowledge of Cosmos DB, MSSQL – SQL etc.
* Experience with usage of TFS
* Familiar UI testing and Unit Testing (MS Test/ Jasmine/ MOQ/ NUnit/ Karma etc.)
* Good understanding of object\-oriented programming (OOP)
* Strong working knowledge of SOLID principles and design patterns that includes Creational, Structural, Behavioral
* Strong experience in designing and working with n\-tier architectures
* Able to provide technical recommendations and solve technical problems
* Should have working knowledge on Code review that includes, raising code review, resolve comment reviews, Closing code reviews.
* Should be aware of best practices in programming
* Should know how to troubleshoot performance\-related issues, how to write efficient code and query, how to use SQL profiler
* Working knowledge Authentication and Authorization \[Plus OAuth2, OpenIDC etc.] (5\+)
* Should have worked on at least one SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) project
* Should have worked in an AGILE practice methodology (preferably SCRUM)

**Desirable Experience**  

  

Strong orientation towards Performance tuning and optimization with Microsoft technologies

 **Additional Information** **Personal Skills:**

* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.

**PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA**: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half\-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

 This role isn't about grooming a backlog, shipping features, or reviewing dashboards. You'll own the telecalling product end to end: its productivity, contactability, conversion, quality, and unit economics, and run it like the business\-critical engine it is
 



 .You're not joining to build another dialer. You're joining to build the operating system that will define how telecalling is done over the next decade.

 t. Turn borrower behaviour and contactability into intelligent queues that maximise productive conversations, not call volume.

 l. Surface borrower context and next\-best\-action, and bring real\-time and post\-call assistance to the floor.

 n. Make compliant flows, consent, audit trails, and automated evaluation part of the product, not a manual process bolted on.

**If those excite you more than yesterday's dashboards, you'll probably love it here.** 




  





**What you bring** 




**The non\-negotiables first:** 



* Owned an operational product, workflow, or funnel end to end, at scale. Real ownership, past tense, not adjacent involvement.

* Dual\-audience range. You earn an ops floor's trust fast, and you're safe in front of enterprise (FI)



  





**Stakeholders and ideally:** 



* 4 to 6 years in product, having independently owned a complex product or platform.
* Deep partnership with engineering on technical systems and integrations.
* Experience with operations heavy products.
* Genuine excitement about using AI to solve real operational problems.



  





**Why DPDzero** 




 This isn't another product role. You'll work directly with collections leaders, operation and data science teams and engineers to build the operating system powering the next generation of telecalling. Instead of shipping features onto yesterday's process, you'll define tomorrow's.

jobs.title: Product Manager -Platform
jobs.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.
   

  

 If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!
   

  

 Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a
 **Product Manager\-Platform** 
 to be part of making this/that happen.
   

  

**Position Overview And Objective**
 You'll join a team shaping the frontier of how AI and automated systems reach Arctic Wolf's platform. This posting covers two related focus areas: permissioning and access\-control systems (how system roles and access models work across single\-tenant and multi\-tenant/MSP customers), and developer platform and MCP (the public developer experience for discovering and adopting access to the platform). Through the interview process, we'll work with you to identify which focus area best fits your background and interests, so you don't need to know which one you are before applying.
   

  

 Both areas are technical and platform\-facing, and both will involve partnering closely with engineering on system design, including reviewing high\-level design documents (HLDs) and building prototypes or proofs of concept to validate direction before committing to full engineering investment. Depending on focus area, your work may be primarily internal\-facing (systems used by internal teams and technical partners) or may extend to a public\-facing surface, where developers and technical evaluators can explore and adopt platform capabilities before they're a customer at all.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and prioritize product requirements for new programmatic and AI\-driven access capabilities (API, protocol\-based, or natural\-language interfaces), or for the systems and roles that govern access to them.
* Partner with engineering on technical design and tradeoffs, including reviewing HLDs and providing product input on technical approach.
* Build prototypes and proofs of concept to validate product direction ahead of full engineering investment.
* Work cross\-functionally with engineering and business stakeholders to ensure new capabilities are properly scoped, tested, and governed before release.
* Represent the needs of the people and systems that depend on your area, whether internal technical partners, external developers, or both.
* Track adoption, usage, and technical health metrics to guide roadmap decisions.


**Experience \& Requirements**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally with technical, platform, or developer\-facing products.
* Experience in one or more of the following: role\-based access control (RBAC), identity, or permissioning systems across single\- or multi\-tenant models; or API/protocol design, developer platforms, and public/self\-serve product experiences.
* Comfortable partnering directly with engineers on technical specifications and tradeoffs, including reviewing and giving product input on technical design documents.
* Experience building prototypes or PoCs to validate product direction ahead of full engineering investment.
* Strong communicator able to translate between technical and business stakeholders.
* Thrives operating in an evolving architecture with real ambiguity, and is comfortable with scope shifting as the space matures.


**Why This Role**
 This is real technical ownership, not requirements administration. You'll partner directly with engineering on systems that the rest of the platform depends on, with genuine architectural input: reviewing HLDs, shaping tradeoffs, and building prototypes to test direction before engineering commits. You'll join a small team at the ground floor of one of the first governed AI\-access layers in the security industry, with a growth path shaped by how fast this space matures, not a fixed org chart.
   

  

**What You Get**
 Arctic Wolf is recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100, Fortune Cyber 60, and named a Top Workplace across multiple regions, backed by a platform trusted by 7,000\+ customers worldwide. In Bangalore, that comes with flexible annual leave and paid volunteer days, training and career development programs, comprehensive private medical coverage for you and your family, life insurance at 3x compensation, personal accident insurance, and fertility support and paid parental leave.
   

  

**On\-Camera Policy**
 To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
   

  

**About Arctic Wolf**
 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021\-2025\), Best Places to Work – USA (2021\-2025\), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021\-2024\), Great Place to Work – UK (2024\-2026\), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024\-2026\). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide…

Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.
   

  

 If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!
   

  

 Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a
 **Product Manager\-Platform** 
 to be part of making this/that happen.
   

  

**Position Overview And Objective**
 You'll join a team shaping the frontier of how AI and automated systems reach Arctic Wolf's platform. This posting covers two related focus areas: permissioning and access\-control systems (how system roles and access models work across single\-tenant and multi\-tenant/MSP customers), and developer platform and MCP (the public developer experience for discovering and adopting access to the platform). Through the interview process, we'll work with you to identify which focus area best fits your background and interests, so you don't need to know which one you are before applying.
   

  

 Both areas are technical and platform\-facing, and both will involve partnering closely with engineering on system design, including reviewing high\-level design documents (HLDs) and building prototypes or proofs of concept to validate direction before committing to full engineering investment. Depending on focus area, your work may be primarily internal\-facing (systems used by internal teams and technical partners) or may extend to a public\-facing surface, where developers and technical evaluators can explore and adopt platform capabilities before they're a customer at all.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and prioritize product requirements for new programmatic and AI\-driven access capabilities (API, protocol\-based, or natural\-language interfaces), or for the systems and roles that govern access to them.

* Build prototypes and proofs of concept to validate product direction ahead of full engineering investment.
* Work cross\-functionally with engineering and business stakeholders to ensure new capabilities are properly scoped, tested, and governed before release.
* Represent the needs of the people and systems that depend on your area, whether internal technical partners, external developers, or both.

* Comfortable partnering directly with engineers on technical specifications and tradeoffs, including reviewing and giving product input on technical design documents.
* Experience building prototypes or PoCs to validate product direction ahead of full engineering investment.
* Strong communicator able to translate between technical and business stakeholders.
* Thrives operating in an evolving architecture with real ambiguity, and is comfortable with scope shifting as the space matures.


**Why This Role**
 This is real technical ownership, not requirements administration. You'll partner directly with engineering on systems that the rest of the platform depends on, with genuine architectural input: reviewing HLDs, shaping tradeoffs, and building prototypes to test direction before engineering commits. You'll join a small team at the ground floor of one of the first governed AI\-access layers in the security industry, with a growth path shaped by how fast this space matures, not a fixed org chart.

 Arctic Wolf is recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100, Fortune Cyber 60, and named a Top Workplace across multiple regions, backed by a platform trusted by 7,000\+ customers worldwide. In Bangalore, that comes with flexible annual leave and paid volunteer days, training and career development programs, comprehensive private medical coverage for you and your family, life insurance at 3x compensation, personal accident insurance, and fertility support and paid parental leave.
   

  

**On\-Camera Policy**

Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
   

  

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.
