We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.

**About Us**
 Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company and one of America’s leading retailers. Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. Are you ready to excel in the fast\-changing retail environment? Are you a customer service enthusiast who’s curious about the guest and can see the shopping journey through their eyes? Then you’ll have success on the Digital Strategy \& Platform team, whose goal is to offer guests a seamless online shopping experience across our platforms—including Target.com and the store network’s fulfillment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness. Your ideas will support Target in complementing the beloved in\-store shopping interaction with a convenient, reliable and instantly gratifying digital experience.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As Product Manager for Grouper you will be instrumental in bringing to life item groups across our Digital and Physical channels curating Bundles, Add\-Ons, Shoppable Collections, and Variations. This role will require you to lead the product identifying item grouping opportunities, connect \& influence multi\-functional teams across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain \& others to influence decisions, leverage machine learning, define product – technology strategy and roadmap, work with data sciences and technology teams to build capabilities that drive guest engagement and sales. We are looking for someone with strong demonstrable B2C ecommerce product management experience having worked on strategies \& execution in leveraging item groups to drive Cross Sell \& Up Sell with focus on top of the funnel customer experience. Candidate must have previous experience in building greenfield products navigating the challenges in adoption, working through ambiguity \& complex collaboration with interconnected partner systems, solving big data problems, leveraging machine learning, SEO/SEM, with intense data orientation, business outcomes and customer focus. Proven experience in setting vision, strategies, roadmap planning, defining, and tracking success metrics, writing, and pitching business case, ability to tell the story and establish rapport, credibility, and influence in a highly cross\-functional, matrix organization across geographies. Product Teams at Target are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable.
   

  

 As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will partner to develop a comprehensive product strategy, related roadmap and set key business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to leverage the knowledge of your product, as well as customer feedback and establish other relevant data points to assess value, develop business cases, and prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will lead a product and work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product. You will be the “voice of the product” to key stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and that the product team is getting the direction and support that it needs to be successful. You will develop and actively understand the market, maintain a product roadmap and backlog outlining the customer themes, epics, and stories while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders. You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles, and partner with product teams across the organization to help them achieve their goals while pursuing and completing yours. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
   

  

**About You**
 Four\-year degree or equivalent experience
   

  

* 4\+ years of product management experience or equivalent domain experience in B2C ecommerce Product Management, building capabilities and driving top of the funnel customer experience
* Proven experience working on strategies \& execution in grouping items to drive Cross Sell \& Up Sell with focus on top of the funnel customer experience.
* Demonstrable experience working on big data problems, leveraging machine learning, putting together product vision \& strategy, writing \& pitching business case and experience in SEO/SEM, A/B tests.
* Experience working on back\-end (services) \& Frontend Top of Funnel Experience.
* Strong communication \& influencing skills with proven ability to lead \& influence highly cross functional, matrix organization across geographies.
* Experience working in an agile environment (e.g., user stories, personas, iterative development, scrum teams)

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
India \- Bangalore


Professional Services/Full time/Onsite

  



Guidewire is seeking a hands\-on DevOps Engineer and Security Champion to join our Professional Services AI Engineering team in Bangalore. You will be the single owner of security implementation across our internal AI Engineering platform and the AI productization projects it supports.  

This is an execution\-focused security role with real input into security strategy. You partner with Product to shape security guidance and own its correct implementation across our infrastructure, applications, and developer workflows — knowing when a decision belongs at the policy level and escalating it accordingly. You will pair closely with the Platform Architect and Strike Team developers to bake security into every layer of the system.


**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Authentication: Stand up and operate authentication flows across all Strike Team projects — JWT, AWS Cognito, SSO integrations, and machine\-to\-machine auth patterns.
* Authorization \& Access Controls: Implement role\-based and attribute\-based access control patterns. Maintain a reusable authorization library that Strike Teams consume rather than rebuild.
* Compliance Implementation: Translate compliance requirements (SOC 2, regional data privacy, customer\-driven controls) into concrete technical controls — encryption, key management, audit logging, data residency.
* IP \& Network Controls: Implement IP restrictions, VPC\-level network segmentation, and traffic policies that protect customer data without blocking legitimate Strike Team workflows.
* Security Patterns Library: Build and maintain a library of vetted security components (auth middleware, secret management helpers, audit log clients) that every Strike Team uses by default.
* Security Reviews \& Audit Support: Review Strike Team designs for security gaps, support customer audits, and partner with the QA Architect on security\-focused testing standards.

**KPIs \& Success Metrics**

* Security controls implemented across all Strike Team projects (auth, authz, encryption, audit logging) with no critical gaps.
* Reusable security library adoption — of teams consuming vetted components rather than rebuilding.
* Compliance readiness: SOC 2 and data\-privacy controls in place; successful customer audit support.
* Time\-to\-remediate security findings within SLA.
* Zero preventable authentication or access\-control incidents.

**Key Skills \& Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field.
* Experience: 8\+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on security implementation — auth systems, compliance controls, or platform security.
* Technical Proficiency:


– Expert\-level knowledge of authentication and authorization patterns (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, SAML).


– Hands\-on experience with AWS Cognito, IAM, KMS, and Secrets Manager.


– Strong backend development skills (Python, Java, or TypeScript) — this is a hands\-on engineering role, not a pure advisory one.


– Working knowledge of common compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and how to translate them into engineering controls.


– Familiarity with secure CI/CD patterns and supply\-chain security (SBOM, dependency scanning).

* Engineering Excellence: Track record of shipping production\-grade security components. Comfortable being a coding security engineer, not just a reviewer.
* Domain Context: (Preferred) Experience in regulated industries (insurance, finance, healthcare) or multi\-tenant SaaS.


Preferred Skills \& Experience

* AI Security: Experience securing LLM\-based applications — prompt injection defenses, output filtering, model access controls.
* Cloud Security: AWS Security Specialty certification or equivalent.
* Guidewire Knowledge: Familiarity with Guidewire Cloud security model.
* Threat Modeling: Hands\-on experience running threat modeling sessions for production systems.

Interested in this position?


  
**About Guidewire**


Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.


As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.


For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.


Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solution Architect
jobs.description:
The **XBL Enterprise Solution Architect** is responsible for co\-defining and governing the technology architecture strategy for healthcare solutions that enhance patient, provider, and customer experiences. This role ensures that enterprise digital solution, customer service solution, and healthcare workflows are scalable, secure, interoperable, and aligned with business objectives from a SHS customer service function and X\-ray products business. The enterprise solution architect works closely with Global CES leadership, Global XP leadership, other stakeholders, customer service teams, product management, and engineering organizations to deliver exceptional outcomes while maintaining regulatory compliance.
**Key Responsibilities** **Architecture Strategy \& Leadership across CES and XP*** Define and drive the enterprise architecture vision, roadmap, and technology standards for healthcare solutions.
* Align architecture decisions with business goals, customer service objectives, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Lead architecture governance, technology evaluation, and solution design reviews.
* Establish architectural best practices, reference architectures, and reusable frameworks.
**Customer Experience \& Service Excellence*** Design customer\-centric healthcare platforms that improve patient experience, caregivers experience, service engineers experience, and support operations.
* Architect solutions that enable omnichannel customer support including AI\-assisted channels.
* Improve customer service effectiveness through automation, self\-service capabilities, CRM integration, and intelligent workflows.
* Drive initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction, reduce resolution times, and improve service quality metrics.
* Ensure seamless customer journeys across healthcare ecosystems, including providers, payers, pharmacies, and care coordinators.
**Technology, Innovation, execution and delivery*** Lead adoption of cloud technologies, AI/ML, analytics, and automation to improve the quality and speed of delivery and outcomes.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovations that improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Develop scalable and resilient architectures supporting enterprise growth.
* Along with the CES and XP team leadership, Drive predictable execution and support in quality delivery
* Validates customer, market or contract requirements, clarifies understanding and feasibility and translates them into system requirements.
* Cooperates with customers in assessing and optimizing system specifications.
* Is guided by maturity, vision, depth of domain and technical experience and the ability to identify, analyse, and decide on relevant issues in time and with courage, even in the absence of complete information.
**Security, Compliance \& Risk Management*** Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations and data privacy requirements.
* Define security architecture for healthcare data protection and customer information management.
* Lead risk assessments and ensure architectural controls meet regulatory and cybersecurity requirements.
**Stakeholder Management*** Partner with business stakeholders, customer service leaders, product owners, and subject matter experts to drive buy\-in and hence the outcomes.
* Communicate architectural strategies and roadmap to senior leadership.
* Collaborate with vendors, strategic partners to drive results.
**Team Leadership \& Mentoring*** Build and mentor the architects, SKEs and leaders within the organization.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer\-centric thinking.
* Guide architects and engineering teams through complex transformation programs.
* Champion architecture excellence across the organization

jobs.description:
We are seeking a seasoned Technical Product Owner to guide the evolution of our high\-traffic Sports and News mobile applications, working in close partnership with the Product Owner. This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between business objectives, user needs, and technical execution, with a primary focus on backend systems and APIs. A core responsibility will be empowering our Scrum teams by meticulously refining user stories related to these backend components, ensuring they are clear, concise, and fully prepared for development sprints, thereby maximizing team velocity and product quality.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Product Vision \& Roadmap Collaboration: Collaborate with the Product Owner and product leadership to define and articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Sports and News mobile applications, ensuring alignment with company goals and technical feasibility.
* Backlog Management \& Prioritization (Backend Focus): In partnership with the Product Owner, manage, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog for the mobile apps, with a specific focus on backend services, APIs, and their integration with the mobile front\-end. Ensure the backlog is transparent, well\-understood, and reflects the highest value opportunities.
* Story Refinement \& Readiness (Backend \& API Emphasis): Lead and facilitate rigorous backlog refinement sessions, particularly for backend\-focused user stories, with the Scrum development team (engineers, QA, designers). This includes:
* Breaking down epics and larger features related to backend systems and APIs into granular, well\-defined user stories.
* Clearly articulating functional requirements, technical specifications, and user needs for backend services.
* Defining precise, testable acceptance criteria for API endpoints and backend logic.
* Ensuring all backend stories meet the team's agreed\-upon "Definition of Ready" (DoR) before sprint planning, minimizing ambiguity and enabling efficient development.
* Technical Liaison \& API Definition: Act as the primary technical point of contact for the mobile development team and backend engineering teams, translating business requirements into actionable technical tasks for APIs and services, and providing necessary context. Contribute to the design and definition of new APIs and backend services, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and meet the functional and non\-functional requirements of the mobile applications.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with various stakeholders, including the Product Owner, business units, editorial teams, marketing, and UX/UI designers, to gather requirements, solicit feedback, and ensure alignment. Act as a key liaison between the Product Owner and the engineering teams for backend initiatives.
* Agile Process Facilitation: Actively participate in all Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives), providing ongoing clarification and support to the team, especially regarding backend and API implementations.
* Quality Assurance Support (Backend \& API): Work closely with QA to ensure test ability of backend features and API integrations, and validate that implemented solutions meet acceptance criteria.
* Performance Monitoring (Backend Systems): Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to backend service health, API response times, and data integrity, as well as user feedback, to inform future iterations and identify areas for improvement.



  





 Requirements
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in a Product Owner, Technical Product Manager, or similar role, with a significant portion focused on backend systems or API development within mobile application contexts.
* Proven experience working within an Agile/Scrum framework, with a strong emphasis on backlog grooming and story refinement techniques, particularly for backend services.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, concise, and comprehensive user stories and acceptance criteria for backend functionalities and APIs.
* Solid understanding of the mobile application development lifecycle (iOS and/or Android) and how it interfaces with backend systems.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience with backlog management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
* Analytical mindset with a passion for data\-driven decision\-making.
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Experience working on high\-volume consumer\-facing applications, particularly in the Sports or News media domain.
* Technical background or a strong understanding of mobile technologies, RESTful APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification.



  





 Benefits
 



 What We Offer
 


* Competitive salaries and comprehensive health benefits
* Flexible work hours and remote work options
* Professional development and training opportunities
* A supportive and inclusive work environment
* Access to cutting\-edge technology and tools.

Confidently discuss the ?why? of the capabilities that are being developed, discuss technical trade\-offs, and challenge proposals to ensure every development is optimized for value delivery, performance, scalability, and security.

jobs.description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.
   

  

 Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.
   

  

**The Role In One Line**
 You own a product, not a backlog. This is the product owner seat on our largest enterprise engagement, an FMCG business running its distribution, field sales and commerce stack on our platform. You take requirements from CXOs, you sit with the people who use the product every day, and you decide what gets built.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* The whole product, not the next feature. You hold the full picture of the product in your head — how the modules connect, what the platform is becoming, and where today's release sits inside it. Priorities move week to week and that is fine. What does not move is your judgement on whether a request fits the product or bolts on to the side of it. You say no to the ones that bolt on, and you can explain why to the person who asked.
* The CXO relationship. Requirements and priorities come from senior business leadership on the client side. You run those conversations yourself. You come out of them with a decision, not a list of things to check with someone else.
* The daily user. The same product is used by field sales officers, distributors and area managers every single day. You spend time with them, in the market, not on a call. What they tell you carries the same weight as what leadership tells you, and reconciling the two is your job.
* Build to live. You gather the requirement, write the spec, prototype it yourself with AI coding tools, work with engineering through the build, test it, and stay on it through deployment. You are involved at every stage, not at the two ends.
* Speed. Enterprise timelines on this account are measured in days. You move at that pace and you hold the team to it.


**Who You Are**
* A product owner, not a facilitator. You make calls. You are not running a status meeting between two teams and reporting what they said. When the requirement is unclear or two stakeholders want opposite things, you decide and defend it.
* Technically hands\-on. You read SQL and PRs, follow a system diagram, and build working prototypes with AI coding tools instead of writing a 12\-page document about what you want. You can run a QA pass yourself, walk a deployment, and check a log when something breaks at 9 PM.
* Comfortable in the room and in the field. You hold your own with a CDO on strategy in the morning and with a distributor's data entry operator in the afternoon. Neither conversation rattles you.
* Fast on new domains. FMCG distribution has its own logic: primary and secondary sales, schemes, claims, beat plans, route to market. You do not need to know it on day one. You need to know it by week four.
* Urgent by default. You close loops the same day. Nobody has to follow up with you twice.


**What "AI\-native" means here (and we mean it)**
 This role assumes you already work differently because AI exists:
   

  

* You operate with AI as a force multiplier. LLM tools, agents, and automation are part of how you draft specs, query data, prototype, and compress the boring parts of the job. You show up faster because of it, and you can point to what you've built or automated.
* You can hold a technical AI conversation. You reason credibly about APIs, retrieval, evals, tokens, and latency\-versus\-cost trade\-offs. You don't need to train a model, but you won't get bluffed by an ML or engineering team, and you can spec an AI\-touching feature without hand\-waving.


 If AI is a thing you occasionally ask a chatbot about, this isn't your role. If it's changed how you work, keep reading.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 4\+ years in product management or product ownership at a product\-first or platform company. We weight ownership and AI fluency over years.
* Track record of owning a product line end to end, including the parts that were not fun.
* Direct experience managing senior business stakeholders, ideally client side.
* Strong analytical instinct. You pull and read the data yourself.
* Experience in SaaS, platform, e\-commerce or enterprise distribution software.
* Working command of Agile or Kanban and the tools that run them.
* Bachelor's in Business, Computer Science or a related field. PMP or CSM is a plus, not a gate.


**Nice to have**
* FMCG, CPG or retail distribution background. DMS, SFA or trade promotion exposure.
* You have owned an AI\-touching surface and can talk about its failure modes.
* You have built internal tools or automations to make your own team faster.
* A past life close to engineering.


**How We'll Evaluate**
 Expect to walk us through a product you owned end to end — the trade\-offs you made, what the data changed, what you cut and why. We will ask what you built yourself. We will ask about the hardest stakeholder conversation you have had and how it ended.
   

  

**What do we offer?**
**Growth**
 At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we’re seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.
   

  

 We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.

jobs.title: Sr Business & Information Analyst
jobs.description:
The Sr Business \& Information Analyst is a skilled, independent problem\-solver who partners with technology and business teams across Disney Experiences to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements for digital and data\-driven solutions. In this role, you will help shape guest and consumer experiences across theme parks, resorts, cruise, vacation, travel, retail, and consumer products by ensuring that technology initiatives deliver meaningful business value.

**Responsibilities:**


As a Sr Business \& Information Analyst, you will act as a proficient, effective resource for colleagues, working independently with minimal guidance to lead moderately complex analysis and portfolio activities that support Disney Experiences' technology and business strategies. Your work will focus on understanding business problems, defining requirements, supporting planning and funding processes, and enabling data\-driven decisions that enhance guest and customer experiences, making this role critical to delivering innovative, customer\-focused solutions.

* Engage with business stakeholders to understand complex needs, identify the real issues or opportunities, and define technology and service requirements that maximize business value.
* Capture, document, and manage requirements using workshops, document analysis, process modeling, and mapping techniques, ensuring traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop business cases and portfolio documentation that align benefits with strategic and tactical objectives, supporting feasibility assessments and funding decisions for new and existing initiatives.
* Support annual and long\-range planning activities, including operating and capital planning, by consolidating financial and portfolio data and preparing executive\-facing summaries and reports.
* Perform data analysis and visualization to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform decisions, using tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and modern analytics platforms.
* Recommend process and technology improvements that enhance operational efficiency, portfolio transparency, and program effectiveness, contributing to continuous improvement efforts.
* Provide subject matter expertise on business processes and systems, assisting teams in resolving questions related to requirements, documentation, and delivery expectations.
* Mentor and guide other analysts on best practices and standards in business analysis, helping to develop consistent methods and quality across the team.
* Support change management and stakeholder engagement activities to ensure end users and support teams are prepared for new solutions and that benefits and impacts are clearly communicated.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in business analysis, data/portfolio analysis, strategy, or a closely related field.
* Experience applying business analysis techniques, including information gathering, requirements documentation, process modeling, and process mapping.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a track record of supporting planning, portfolio management, and process improvement initiatives.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for analysis, reporting, and executive\-ready presentations.
* Understanding of the technical project lifecycle and delivery, including familiarity with software development methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Familiarity with data visualization and big data concepts using tools such as Power BI or Tableau and relational data principles.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and explain difficult or sensitive concepts clearly.
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in evolving, broadly defined roles and processes through self\-reliance, resourcefulness, and independent work.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment and support executive forums, leadership updates, and portfolio reporting.
* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Information Technology, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exceptional storytelling and visualization skills, with the ability to transform complex analysis into clear, engaging presentations for executives.
* Experience with scripting or automation tools such as SQL, Python, or Power Automate to support advanced analytics and workflow automation.
* Background in disciplines such as Commercial Strategy, Business Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Portfolio Management, Decision Science, Consumer Insights, or Finance.
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Technology, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

* Research, evaluate, and experiment with emerging technologies in AI, data, and process automation (e.g., GenAI, Agentic AI, process mining).

**Solution Design \& Delivery**
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into automation and AI solution designs.

* Conduct performance analysis of AI\-driven automations, refining models and prompts through data\-driven insights.

**Process Transformation \& Enablement**
* Conduct process assessments and root\-cause analyses to identify automation opportunities across functions (e.g., accounting, MPIM, operations).
* Create process maps, automation blueprints, and KPI frameworks to measure efficiency and ROI.
* Support documentation, training, and knowledge sharing to foster a culture of innovation and citizen development.
* Partner with global stakeholders to ensure consistency, scalability, and best\-practice alignment across regions.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Economics, Innovation Management, or related field.

* Knowledge of data structures, APIs, and prompt optimization techniques.
* Ability to analyze technology trends and translate insights into practical business applications.
* Excellent English communication and storytelling skills (written and verbal).
